title: Lakshya Sen Makes History, First Indian in Japan Masters Final
indian_angle: Lakshya Sen's entry into the Japan Masters final marks a historic first for an Indian player in this tournament.
summary: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen has become the first-ever Indian to reach the summit clash of the Japan Masters since its inception in 2023, following his victory over Alwi Farhan.

title: Lakshya Sen Defeats Alwi Farhan to Reach Kumamoto Masters Final
indian_angle: This victory secures Lakshya Sen's spot in his second consecutive BWF tour final, highlighting his strong form.
summary: Lakshya Sen defeated Alwi Farhan to advance to the Kumamoto Masters Japan final, marking his second consecutive BWF tour final appearance after winning the HYLO Open.

title: Lakshya Sen Advances to Kumamoto Masters Semifinals
indian_angle: Lakshya Sen continues his strong performance by reaching the semifinals, building on his recent Hylo Open win.
summary: Eighth seed Lakshya Sen, fresh off his Hylo Open victory, has entered the semifinals of the Kumamoto Masters Japan, maintaining his good form.
